root_cause_summary: Severe winter temperature inversion trapping elevated vehicular combustion and regional biomass smoke at ground level under low atmospheric boundary layer.

commuter.departure_window_advice: Defer non-essential morning outdoor travel until surface mixing layer lifts (optimal window: 13:00 - 15:30 IST).
commuter.transit_route_advice: Prioritize subterranean Metro corridors over exposed arterial bypasses; maintain cabin HVAC on closed loop isolation.

school.recess_guidance: Immediately suspend all outdoor physical education, playground recesses, and open-air assemblies; direct students to indoor facilities.
school.ventilation_window_timing: Maintain sealed envelope throughout morning hours; execute short filtered cross-ventilation only between 13:30 - 14:15 IST.

facilities.damper_and_filtration_advice: Clamp all external fresh-air AHU intake dampers to 0% (Isolated Loop) to prevent particulate ingress. Verify static filter differential pressure.
facilities.pre_scrub_advice: Initiate high-efficiency HEPA/carbon filtration pre-scrub purge 60 minutes prior to shift changes.

municipal.civic_action_detail: Deploy anti-smog mist cannons and high-pressure water tankers along upwind industrial and transport arteries.
